envelope.title: D-107 · Check capacity before assigning consultants
envelope.body:
A fictional recorded product decision. The quotation explains the reason; it is not a claim that this policy applies to every project.

D-107 is about Infrastructure Alerts: check capacity before assigning consultants so delivery teams avoid over-allocation.
